# Free CC0 Industrial 3D Models

A downloadable asset pack

[Download Now](https://3dmodelscc0.itch.io/free-cc0-industrial-3d-models/purchase)Name your own price

Collection of 12 unique 3D industrial props, all offered under a CC0 public domain license.

Previously hosted on 3DModelsCC0, which is no longer operational due to high upkeep costs and low revenue, these models will be consolidated into bundles and made available for free on itch.io.

This pack contains these 3D assets:

* Cable Drum
* Car Jack
* Electrical Box
* Electriacl Box Large
* Explosive Barrel
* Gas Can
* Gas Cylinder
* Pallet Truck
* Platform Trolley
* Water Barrel
* Work Light Small
* Work Light Large

If you find value in these models and wish to help offset the challenges I faced while hosting the site, your kind donation would be sincerely appreciated.

Stay tuned for the next upload on itch.io.
